info.description: Complete API collection for CycleX Recycling Mobile Application. Converted from Postman JSON to rbc-style XML.
info.notes: Authentication is session-based (auth_token cookie). Use base_url variable to change host/port.

request.name: 1.1 Register User
request.description: Register a new user (customer or collector). Required: name, phone, password, user_type. Optional: email, language.

request.name: 1.2 Verify Phone
request.description: Verify phone number with 6-digit code. Returns auth session on success.

request.name: 1.3 Login
request.description: Login with phone and password. Returns user data and auth session.

request.name: 1.4 Resend Verification Code
request.description: Resend verification code to phone. Rate limited to prevent abuse.

request.name: 2.1 Get Categories
request.description: Get all active recycling categories. Optional: language (ar/en).

request.name: 2.2 Get Products
request.description: Get products by category. Required: category_id. Optional: language.

request.name: 3.1 Create Request
request.description: Create a new recycling request. Required: product_id, quantity, unit, pickup_date, pickup_time, location_latitude, location_longitude, address. Optional: notes, image (base64).
request.body: { "jsonrpc": "2.0", "method": "call", "params": { "product_id": 1, "quantity": 15.5, "unit": "kg", "pickup_date": "2025-10-20", "pickup_time": "morning", "location_latitude": 30.0444, "location_longitude": 31.2357, "address": "123 شارع التحرير، القاهرة", "notes": "Please call before arriving", "image": "base64_encoded_image_string_here" }, "id": 7 }

request.name: 3.2 My Requests
request.description: Get customer's requests. Optional: status, limit, offset.

request.name: 3.3 Request Details
request.description: Get detailed request information. Required: request_id.

request.name: 3.4 Rate Request
request.description: Rate a completed request. Required: request_id, rating (1-5). Optional: comments.

request.name: 4.1 Available Orders
request.description: Get available orders for collector. Requires verified collector.

request.name: 4.2 Accept Order
request.description: Accept a recycling order. Required: request_id. Business rules apply (max 5 pending, must complete within 3 days).

request.name: 4.3 Reject Order
request.description: Reject an assigned order. Required: request_id. Optional: reason.

request.name: 4.4 Scan QR Code
request.description: Scan QR code to complete order. Validates QR, marks order as collected, credits wallet, creates commission.

request.name: 4.5 My Completed Orders
request.description: Get collector's completed orders. Optional: limit, offset.

request.name: 5.1 Get Balance
request.description: Get current wallet balance. Returns balance and currency.

request.name: 5.2 Get Transactions
request.description: Get wallet transaction history. Optional: limit, offset.

request.name: 5.3 Request Credit (Admin Only)
request.description: Add credit to customer wallet (Admin only). Required: customer_id, amount, description.

request.name: 5.4 Request Withdrawal
request.description: Request wallet withdrawal. Required: amount, description. Business rules: min withdrawal 10 EGP, admin approval required.

request.name: 6.1 Get Profile
request.description: Get user profile information. Returns complete profile data.

request.name: 6.2 Update Profile
request.description: Update user profile. Optional fields: name, email, language. Phone cannot be changed.

request.name: 6.3 Update FCM Token
request.description: Update Firebase FCM token for push notifications. Required: fcm_token.

request.name: 7.1 My Commission
request.description: Get collector commission history. Optional: limit, offset.
